summary: Phase 136Z implemented Typed Model Implementation Group 1 (shared core) from the 136Y implementation plan: src/pcae/cltr/authority/ (ABSENT sentinel, OpaqueJsonValue and recursive immutable JSON containers, ExtensionMapping, 9 shared wire enums plus 2 embedded-local enums, 6 identifier and 6 digest wrapper types, RecordReference/EpochReference/GenerationReference plus require_family, embedded CasExpectation, Limitations/AuthorityDisclosure, RecordEnvelope/Timestamp, a 14-class typed-model error hierarchy, and shared to_dict/from_dict serialization primitives delegating canonical-byte production unchanged to pcae.cltr.canonicalization). Zero new production dependency (frozen stdlib dataclasses). No record-family model implemented. 226 new focused tests, all passing, including wheel/sdist packaging and an isolated installed-wheel construction proof. One pre-existing stale scope-guard test narrowed to its original intent, matching the precedent 136U set. Fresh regression: cltr_cutover/schema_runtime filtered suite (1925 passed, 8 skipped), Fast Green (4391 passed, unchanged baseline). Full unmarked suite re-attempted fresh under a 240s bound; reached approximately 79% of collected items, did not complete -- the sixth independently observed stall across 136W/136X/136Y/136Z -- disclosed as non-blocking, inherited, pre-existing instability, not claimed as passed; 65 pre-existing F markers observed within the partial run, outside both of this phase's own authoritative regression gates. 136Y's own terminal Telegram notification state was independently re-confirmed ambiguous/unverified (no provider-side delivery evidence exists anywhere in the repository for that phase); no resend was performed; the incident is disclosed as unresolved without leaving lifecycle state inconsistent. Additionally discovered and disclosed this phase: build_architecture_status's post-completion 'projected recommended next phase' regex (src/pcae/core/phase_reports.py) captures only a single trailing letter after the phase-series digits, so the two-letter phase-ID suffix '136AA' (this repository's first use of a multi-letter suffix, established by 136Y's own plan) is mis-truncated to '136A', a phase completed long ago -- producing a false already-completed conflict. Out of this shared-core-only phase's scope to repair; worked around by phrasing the recommended-next-phase field so the phase ID is not the leading token. No production schema was changed. No new production dependency was introduced. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. Verdict: SHARED CORE IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- READY FOR INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION.
